_comment: One short-lived operational envelope per analyst reference-data command. The actor performs the deterministic invariant-carrying transform or versioned upsert; success and failure are terminal command outcomes, and no reference-data entity is given a synthetic lifecycle. The envelope carries RESOLVED outcomes only: a publication that remains unresolved after drain has no failed-row delivery and is reported as an unknown-outcome residual outside this machine.

_delays.COMMAND_TIMEOUT: 20000 ms - publication-admission deadline shared by preparation and publication for one provider-backed refresh, versioned upsert, or candidate-set build; preparation never resets it; not a total command return bound
